newsitem.title: USA: American Express takes stake in InfoBeat.
newsitem.headline: American Express takes stake in InfoBeat.

text.p: American Express Co's Travel Related Services unit on Tuesday said it has made a minority investment in InfoBeat, formerly known as Mercury mail.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed, but the company said the deal was part of a total investment of $7.5 million secured by InfoBeat recently secured.

InfoBeat offers a line of free consumer electronic mail (e-mail) services, including InfoBeat News, InfoBeat Finance, InfoBeat Sports, InfoBeat Weather, and InfoBeat Entertainment. The company sends about three million personalized e-mail messages daily. It also provides e-mail delivery products and services for businesses.
